notes: ① 插件更新的进度窗口也照同一规矩收尾：退出后安装那一路（mode=update）跑完不再 3 秒自动消失，把「插件更新已完成 / 日志路径」留在屏幕上，按任意键或点 × 才退出；客户端同样由 explorer 在等待之前拉起，关窗口不影响它。只有 relaunch（纯重启、窗口里没有结果可看）仍旧停 3 秒自动关。② 推送/拉取的窗口收尾行为沿用 0.3.5。
notesEn: (1) The plugin-update progress window now ends the same way: after the install-after-exit path (mode=update) finishes it no longer vanishes 3 seconds later — "plugin update finished + log path" stays on screen until you press a key or click the ×, and the client (relaunched by explorer before the wait) is unaffected when you close it. Only relaunch still closes itself after 3s, since there is no result to read. (2) Pull/push keep the 0.3.5 behaviour.
